title: Honeycomb Dataset
description: Datasets are a collection of events from a specific source or related source.

description.example: A nice description of my dataset

delete_protected.description: If true, the dataset cannot be deleted.

expand_json_depth.description: The maximum unpacking depth of nested JSON fields.

slug.description: The 'slug' of the dataset to be used in URLs.

regular_columns_count.description: The total number of unique fields for this Dataset. The value will be null if the dataset does not contain any fields yet.

last_written_at.description: The ISO8601-formatted time when the dataset last received event data. The value will be null if no data has been received yet.

created_at.description: The ISO8601-formatted time when the dataset was created.

dataset_type.description: The type of data contained in the dataset. Only present for time-series metrics datasets.
